description: Build a self-contained HTML report or paper (report.html) and replication_package.zip from a report.json object (mode report: an exhibit chartbook; mode paper: prose-led). Facts are cited as {{name}} or {{name|fmt}}, references as [@id], footnotes as [^n]; exhibits name a CSV in exhibits/ and a chart {type, x, y, series, ...}. Each source's notices, Data Vintage block and redistribution rules are applied (microdata and withheld rows never enter the ZIP). Every report.json key (chart types and options, cover, notes_page, footnote scoping, clearance, replication) is listed in guide("report_schema"); guide("report") is the short form. Send the report once: later fixes are a patch (no report: the workspace's report.json is rebuilt). Returns the paths and the style score with the sentences to fix; call audit_report next.

patch.description: Changes by dotted path, e.g. {"sections.0.body": "...", "exhibits.1.title": "..."}; null removes a key

report.description: The report.json object (title, mode, sources, at_a_glance, sections, exhibits, methods, ...). Default: the workspace's report.json

name: build_report
title: Build the report
